newsitem.title: GREECE: KARAMANLIS LEANS TOWARDS RUNNING FOR PARTY PRES - SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: KARAMANLIS LEANS TOWARDS RUNNING FOR PARTY PRES - SOURCE.

text.p: Greek conservative New Democracy party's parliamentarian Costas Karamanlis is tilting towards accepting the invitation by 29 fellow parliamentarians to be a candidate for the party presidency, a source close to him told Reuters.
"The odds are in favour of Costas running for the party's presidency at the congress," the source said. "There is momentum for his candidacy and it is picking up steam."
New Democracy party president Miltiadis Evert and conservative parliamentarian George Souflias are expected to run for the party presidency as well.
Karamanlis is now attending a meeting of more than 20 parliamentarians who asked him to run. He will be visiting the city of Tripolis this afternoon.
"I expect him not to reject the invitation to be a candidate, to say the least, at the meeting," he said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
